case.title: Was invoice INV-77 paid?
case.question: Accounts receivable marked invoice INV-77 (AUD 4,200) as paid. Was it actually paid?

hypotheses.statement: Invoice INV-77 has been paid in full.
Only part of invoice INV-77 has been paid.

configuration.speck: Evidence Desk as built: one Speck case carried across the stages on a temporary Speck database (the case on the page is not touched). Each stage's new records are assessed and Speck's beliefs revised; a record replaced by a later one stops counting and the beliefs that rested on it are rebuilt.
configuration.stateless: The evaluation's stateless model baseline: at each stage, one call to the same Nemotron endpoint with the question, the explanations and every visible record (its text, its facts, and "replaces …" where the source says so). It keeps nothing between stages.
configuration.labels: Pre-registered labels from the case's expected.json, written before any system was run on it.

visible.content: Credit AUD 4,200.00 from Hollis Cafe Pty Ltd, reference INV-77.
Invoice INV-77 matched to bank credit and marked paid.

speck.headline: Invoice INV-77 has been paid in full.
reasons: Speck holds H-PAID as supported at 0.66, at or above its supported threshold of 0.6.

explanation.text: The invoice INV-77 has been paid in full, as confirmed by both EV-BNK-101 (bank statement showing a full AUD 4,200 credit) and EV-LDG-102 (ledger marking the invoice as paid). These evidence items support H-PAID and contradict H-UNPAID and H-PARTIAL. The conclusion is established based on the current evidence.

stateless.rationale: The ledger indicates the invoice was marked paid, but the bank statement shows a payment of AUD 4,200 was received, which matches the invoice amount. This suggests the invoice was paid, contradicting the unpaid hypothesis.

stages.disagreement: Speck concludes H-PAID; the stateless call concludes H-UNPAID citing EV-LDG-102.

visible.content: Credit AUD 4,200.00 from Hollis Cafe Pty Ltd, reference INV-77.
Invoice INV-77 matched to bank credit and marked paid.
Debit AUD 4,200.00: payment reference INV-77 returned unpaid (dishonoured, insufficient funds). Reverses the credit of 5 Sep.
Invoice INV-77 reopened after the bank returned the payment.

speck.headline: Invoice INV-77 remains unpaid.
reasons: Speck holds H-UNPAID as active at 0.444, 0.156 short of its supported threshold of 0.6; Speck itself has not established it.

Concluded by corroboration (rule corroborated-1): EV-BNK-103, EV-LDG-104 from 2 different sources (bank, ledger) support it, no record that still counts is against it, and every other explanation is ruled out or has no support.
The gap is Speck's cap on model-judged evidence: EV-BNK-103, EV-LDG-104 were judged by the model, so each adds at most 0.08.

noLongerCounted.explanation: EV-BNK-103 replaces all of EV-BNK-101, not only the facts it restates. No record that still counts states payment.received=true, payment.amount_matches=true. Its judgments no longer apply: contradicts H-PARTIAL decisively; supports H-PAID; contradicts H-UNPAID. H-PARTIAL is no longer ruled out: EV-BNK-101 was its decisive refutation, and it is now proposed at 0.2.
consequences: H-PARTIAL is no longer ruled out: EV-BNK-101 was its decisive refutation, and it is now proposed at 0.2.

noLongerCounted.explanation: Accounts ledger has since reported a newer value for every fact in EV-LDG-102 (ledger.status: paid → reopened in EV-LDG-104), so EV-LDG-102 no longer describes the current state. No record that still counts states ledger.status=paid. Its judgments no longer apply: supports H-PAID; contradicts H-UNPAID; contradicts H-PARTIAL.

revisions.cause: EV-BNK-101 superseded by EV-BNK-103; EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid)
dropped: EV-LDG-102 (EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid))

revisions.cause: EV-BNK-101 superseded by EV-BNK-103; EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid)
dropped: EV-LDG-102 (EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid))

revisions.cause: EV-BNK-101 superseded by EV-BNK-103; EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid)
dropped: EV-LDG-102 (EV-LDG-102 out of date: its source now reports ledger.status=reopened (EV-LDG-104, was paid))

explanation.text: The invoice INV-77 remains unpaid, as both the bank statement (EV-BNK-103) and ledger (EV-LDG-104) show the payment was reversed and the invoice reopened, contradicting H-PAID. The evidence indicates the payment was dishonoured due to insufficient funds, and no further payment has been recorded. The older evidence (EV-BNK-101, EV-LDG-102) is superseded and no longer counts.

stateless.rationale: The bank statement shows the payment was reversed due to insufficient funds, and the ledger status was reopened, indicating the invoice remains unpaid.

notes: Both approaches saw the same records at every stage, the same question and explanations, and the same assessor configuration.

Speck counts a conclusion only when it holds it as supported; a leading or pointed-to explanation is tentative. The stateless baseline has no such threshold beyond answering "unresolved" (model) or a tie or non-positive score (rules).

Differences come from Speck's explicit evidence and revision state and its conclusion policy (thresholds, decisive refutation, supersession), not from persistence alone: the evaluation's speck-fresh system, which rebuilds from scratch each time, reaches the same conclusions as speck-desk.

Live: model judgments vary between runs. This is one sample, not a rate. Speck calls the model per evidence chunk plus once for its explanation; the baseline calls it once per stage, so call counts and latency are not like for like.

Speck caps model-judged evidence at reliability 0.4, so Speck's own confidence rarely reaches its 0.6 threshold live. Since Build 4 Evidence Desk can still conclude by corroboration (two or more source systems agree, nothing recorded against, every rival ruled out or unsupported); each such conclusion is marked, with Speck's own confidence beside it.
